Kua tātarihia ngā pikihekeheke utu o te bazaar, ka aroturukitia anake ngā tāpiritanga me ngā mukunga ā-hanganga o ngā taonga. Ka tango te endpoint packs i te putanga whai uara packFormat nui rawa i ia wā (ka rerekē tēnei tau i ngā whakahōutanga MC); ina rerekē te hash whaimana, ka tiki ia i te zip, ka wewete, ā, ka whakataurite i ngā tāpiritanga, mukunga me ngā huringa o ngā kōnae o te pōkai mā te hash o te ihirangi; mō ngā kōnae kuputuhi kua whakarerekētia, ka whakaatuhia anake te wāhanga kua rerekē me te whero me te kākāriki, ā, ka tohungia ngā kōnae hōu ki te kākāriki anake. Ka tuhia e te endpoint Bingo (bingo) te wā whakaputa, te wā tīmata me te wā mutunga o ia wāhanga, ā, ka rārangihia ngā mahi katoa ki te matiti 5×5 (mai i te mauī ki te matau, mai i runga ki raro; pāwhiritia tētahi pūtau kia kite i te tuhinga katoa); ka tukuna e te kaute whakamuri ngā huringa-iti o te epoch o start / end ki te pūtirotiro, ka tātaitia e ia ia hēkona, nō reira kāore e pāngia e te whakaroa o te tiki a Actions; ka whakaatuhia ngā waehere tae Minecraft (§) o te tuhinga mahi ki te papatae whaimana, ā, ko te ahunga whakamua o te tūmau katoa he mea whakaatu anake, kāore e uru ki te whakatauritenga. Ka tikitia anō te endpoint o ngā hokonga wā poto (firesales) i ia whakahaerenga (i mua i te tīmatanga o tētahi hokonga ka taea e te taha whaimana te huri i te wā/te maha/te utu); ka puta ia hokonga ki tōna ake kāri me te utu me te maha, ā, mā te pātene «Whakaatuhia ngā raraunga anō» e huaki ngā wāhanga katoa me te JSON taketake.
